problemStatements.title: AI-Powered Education Assistant
problemStatements.description: Develop an intelligent teaching assistant that analyzes student performance in real-time, recommends personalized micro-lessons, and answers concepts dynamically using rag structures.
problemStatements.summary: An adaptive LLM teaching copilot parsing student learning graphs to optimize custom content delivery.
roadmap: Setup Next.js dashboard template and FastAPI router backend
Index reference syllabus and textbook documents in Pinecone vector store
Build context retrievers with LangChain and construct custom system prompt chats
Wire charts visualizing student progress analytics and package the system for demo
deliverables: Fully functional dynamic learning dashboard repository link
Deployed backend endpoints serving real-time prompt generation
Pitch Deck PDF & 3-minute demo video outlining architecture
problemStatements.innovationTips: Incorporate audio-to-text inputs so children can voice questions directly, making the tool much more accessible.
problemStatements.challenges: Hallucinations in complex subjects and high API response latency under heavy load.
ideas: EduQuest AI - An RPG game where answers unlock steps in a learning adventure
SyllabusSift - A browser extension synthesizing study guides from PDF slides

problemStatements.title: Automated Legal Document Analyzer
problemStatements.description: Create a secure web app that audits uploaded lease agreements, identifies hidden liability clauses, and outlines potential warnings automatically.
problemStatements.summary: A contract risk analysis engine scanning document texts for red flags, non-competes, and liabilities.
roadmap: Create document upload portal and configure PDF-to-text parser
Design heuristic parsing rule sets and fine-tuned LLM classifier models
Construct glassmorphism summary report cards detailing detected clauses
Add high-contrast risk level badges and exportable clean reports
deliverables: Code repository link containing the audit server
A web portal showing interactive risk cards side-by-side with document text
problemStatements.innovationTips: Highlight precise sentences in the contract viewer using matching risk color codes (yellow for caution, red for warning).
problemStatements.challenges: Parsing scanned image PDFs accurately, and handling long dense contracts exceeding standard token contexts.
ideas: LeaseGuard - A quick scan utility for students renting college rooms
NDA-Sifter - A tool specifically optimized for parsing commercial NDAs

problemStatements.title: Cross-chain DeFi Yield Aggregator
problemStatements.description: Design a smart contract suite and frontend dashboard that dynamically shifts client tokens across different protocol layers to lock in top yields, accounting for gas price metrics.
problemStatements.summary: Gas-aware cross-chain capital allocation vaults utilizing smart liquidity sweeps.
roadmap: Write Foundry test suite verifying yield yield rates across mock protocols
Implement main routing vault smart contracts with gas optimization tricks
Create responsive dashboard showing APYs, pool allocations, and deposit states
Integrate wallet connections (WalletConnect/RainbowKit) and run transaction test routes
deliverables: Verified smart contract addresses on Sepolia testnet
GitHub repository including smart contract tests and dashboard layout
problemStatements.innovationTips: Add one-click auto-compounding features so that yields are re-deposited without requiring manual transaction triggers.
problemStatements.challenges: High gas fee variability and transient slippage issues during chain rebalances.
ideas: YieldVault AI - A neural network model predicting future interest rate drops
SweepDeFi - A gas optimized aggregator routing assets across Arbitrum and Optimism

messages.content: Hey Vishvapal! I saw your profile and noticed you have great React and Node.js skills. Would you be interested in joining our team 'Prompt Engineers' for the OpenAI GenAI Buildathon?
Hi Sarah! Yes, I'd love to check it out. The educational assistant project sounds super exciting! I have built some chat layouts and API integrations in Next.js before.
Awesome! I've already set up the vector database and standard API triggers. We just need to build a premium dashboard and polish the student prompt interface.
